operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers everywhere ("Region_ID", "Took_office", "Member_in_charge_ID"); must double-quote with original case.
DDL uses backtick-quoted FK refs (`Region_ID`) inside CREATE TABLE while columns are double-quoted; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
member.Party_ID declared TEXT but FK to party.Party_ID (INT) and stores '1','2','3' as text; storage class contradicts declared type.
party.Party_name has a numeric-looking value '3' among text names (mixed storage in a text column).
region.Date is TEXT storing '1 July 2002' style dates (day month-name year), not ISO; ts_fuzzer=String so no date parsing.
party.Took_office/Left_office are TEXT storing bare years '1957'..'1962' (int-like strings in text column).
member.In_office stores en-dash ranges '1994–present' (U+2013), not ASCII hyphen.
party_events has two FKs (Party_ID->party, Member_in_charge_ID->member); member itself FKs party, so party_events is level 2.
All PKs are single-column INT with no NOT NULL declared (notnull=0) yet no NULLs in original.
Tiny tables (5/5/15/8 rows); original_values sampling k=min(5,len) will pull nearly the whole table for region/party.
region.Region_name distinct=3 over 5 rows (duplicates); party.Minister distinct=4 over 5; ties exist in original.
FK child member.Party_ID distinct=3 vs parent party 5 rows; party_events.Party_ID distinct=3, Member_in_charge_ID distinct=7 of 15.
operator_ts_expectations: All INT columns -> Number fuzzer scale=0: fresh draws uniform in [-1,1] then int perturb +-1/+-2, so PKs collapse to a handful of small ints -> heavy PK-duplicate dropping.
All TEXT columns -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0..20 plus contaminate; names/dates/years become gibberish -> implausible values (FN source).
region.Date, Took_office, In_office are String not Date: TS never produces '1 July 2002' or '1994–present' formats -> format predicates miss.
member.Party_ID (TEXT) gets String fuzzer, but FK fill overrides with parent party.Party_ID values (ints) -> type mismatch text vs int in child.
FK fill draws from parent FINAL filtered column with replacement; small parent (5 rows) after PK dedup may be <5 -> many duplicate child FKs, few distinct joins.
Number fuzzer on PKs with max_l0=inf for single-col PK: fresh draws reused after 30, so distinct PK count bounded ~30 -> tables capped small, ties/duplicates likely.
String fuzzer p=0.2 fresh + element reuse from 5 original samples: '3' in Party_name and year strings may reappear, giving accidental matches.
party_events.Member_in_charge_ID FK to member: if member PK dedup shrinks member, many party_events rows get NULL or duplicate member refs.
Number perturb on INT FK columns can push values outside parent range -> FK values not in parent (but FK pragma OFF so inserts succeed) -> dangling refs, join FPs/FNs.
String contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop char) on Event_Name/Minister breaks equality predicates -> FN on exact-name filters.
region 5 rows, party 5, member 15, party_events 8: choose_table_sizes may inflate to 30-2500 rows, diluting original distinct values -> low selectivity, many ties.
Date/Number dispatch: no column hits 'date'/'timestamp'/'year' substring in declared type (all INT/TEXT), so Date fuzzer never used here.
